component.name: RustZilla
component.summary: Fast, native SFTP, FTP(S), WebDAV and S3 client

description.p: RustZilla moves files between your computer and servers, with the layout FileZilla users know: the local and the remote side next to each other, a transfer queue, a message log and a Site Manager.

ul.li: SFTP, FTP, FTPS (explicit and implicit), WebDAV and Amazon S3 and compatible stores
Logins with passwords, key files, the SSH agent and FIDO security keys such as YubiKeys
Parallel transfers of files and folders, with resume and a choice for existing files
Host keys and TLS certificates to trust, passwords kept in the system's keychain

screenshot.caption: Local and remote side with the transfer queue
